scope: Official SQLite documentation and version-pinned SQLite source; examples are independently authored

claims.claim: SQLite documents four independent core test harnesses: TCL, TH3, SQL Logic Test and dbsqlfuzz
TCL tests are in the source tree, public domain and primary development tests
TH3 is a proprietary C test suite with 100% branch and MC/DC coverage for the core library target
SQL Logic Test compares SQL results across multiple database engines
dbsqlfuzz is a proprietary fuzzer that mutates database files and SQL together
OOM and I/O errors are injected with allocator and VFS test doubles; crash tests use simulated VFS/process failure
fuzzcheck replays fuzz inputs and targets crashes/assertions/leaks rather than verifying SQL output
